event_summary: A turtle slowly changes position on a fallen log over still pond water while small water-surface ripples and reflections remain visible.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a fallen log extending diagonally across greenish pond water. A turtle is visible on the lower portion of the log. Across the video, the turtle slowly advances a short distance along the log toward the lower end of the frame, with small changes in the position of its head and body. Thin branches beside the log remain in place. The water surface shows reflected trees and sky with subtle ripple changes.

reasons: The turtle, log, surrounding water, and nearby branches are visible at the start.
The turtle is already on the log when the visible sequence begins.
